newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips jump to sixth straight record.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips jump to sixth straight record.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks jumped to a record for the sixth straight session Friday as a report of tame wholesale inflation in May convinced investors the Federal Reserve was unlikely to raise interest rates next month.

According to early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 70.57 points, or 0.92 percent, to close at 7,782.04. Other market averages also rose, with the Nasdaq index up 11.81 points to 1,423.13 and the Standard & Poor's 500 index up 9.76 points to 893.25.
